system.description: You have a knack for getting others to see things your way. You typically need about 10 minutes of schmoozing in a safe environment to make a Check with this Skill, and you may suffer Disadvantage if the request is risky, inconvenient, or untoward. Make an INT-Opposed Skill Check. On Success, you convince the target to follow your suggestion if it isn't too costly for them, too dangerous, or against their nature.

upgrades.description: They'll follow your suggestion even if it is costly for them.
They'll follow your suggestion even if it is dangerous.
They'll follow your suggestion even if it's against their nature.
